# NetAesthetics — AI Implementation Partner

> We build AI into your business. Strategy through deployment in 6 weeks, not 6 months.

## About
NetAesthetics is an AI strategy and implementation firm based in Washington, DC. We help growth companies with $5M to $50M in revenue add AI to their software, automate their operations, and grow faster — without needing an in-house AI team.

Founded in 2005, NetAesthetics has delivered 50+ AI implementations with zero data breaches. Our CEO, Rasheid Karl Scarlett, serves on the FirstNet Authority Board (the $47B nationwide public safety broadband network), bringing government-grade security standards to every engagement.

## Services & Pricing

### AI Opportunity Audit — $9,500 (1 week)
We analyze your business and identify where AI will save the most time and money. Standalone deliverable, no commitment required.

### AI Assessment — $25,000 (2 weeks)
Comprehensive assessment of AI readiness, opportunity mapping, ROI projections, and technology stack evaluation.

### AI Strategy — $49,500 (6 weeks)
Complete step-by-step AI implementation roadmap: what to build first, how to avoid costly mistakes, and competitive intelligence on what others in your industry are doing with AI.

### AI Implementation — $175,000+ (6+ months)
Full-stack AI development from strategy through production deployment. We write the code, integrate with existing systems, ensure security compliance, and train your team.

### Enterprise Custom Solutions — Custom (6-12 months)
Organization-wide AI deployment with dedicated team, monthly performance reporting, and continuous optimization.
